MECA.TITLE: Display Flow in Warning Display Mode

ITEM.PTXT: When a system malfunction occurs (when each condition is met), the corresponding warning is displayed and the master warning indicator light illuminates or blinks. In addition, when a warning first occurs, the buzzer in the meter sounds according to the warning display item to alert the driver promptly.

If there are multiple warning display items, the active warning items are displayed in the following order: the 1 display (when a new warning occurs) is shown for approximately 6 seconds, and from the 2 display onward each is shown for approximately 2 seconds.
